(round 1: Mutations (catalogue file changed, tables.js --write, catalog.js): Harpy points 185→190 fails (texts · points); Shield-Captain per Praesidium Shield 25→30 fails; an option renamed (Twin heavy barbed strangler) fails options; Harpy composition max 1→2 fails; Harpy dropped fails complete. BUT a too-wide grouped composition passes: Termagants group 10-20 → groupMax 25 (and model max 25), or groupMax 30 alone, passes catalog. catalog.js composition takes the variants path (several "<model> w/ …" entries) with sum(min) <= g.min && sum(max) >= g.max and never compares groupMin/groupMax with GW's line, so raising any maximum can never fail; builder.js would then accept 25 Termagants. Fix: in the composition loop, for entries with a group require [groupMin, groupMax] to equal [g.min, g.max] exactly, and in the variants path require every variant's max <= g.max (sum(max) >= g.max stays). The nine declarations: checked by hand against the cached pages (Gyrfalcon Jetbiker 2 = row 2/2; Fiends 1 Blissbringer + 2-5 = row 3-6; Telemon's four loadouts; Totemic Presence) — right. The other-book rule is right: the 21 Chaos Daemons index entries marked "App. Chaos Space Marines" are CSM datasheets (Chaos Lord, Legionaries, Havocs …).)
